name: structurestudio-dev
description: Dev tooling only - the DEPLOY has no build step (compiled artifacts are committed; `npm run compile` regenerates them from the .jsx sources using the vendored babel-standalone as the offline compiler, then minifies with terser). eslint and globals are scripts/preflight.mjs, the pre-push correctness gate; terser is scripts/compile.mjs and is PINNED EXACTLY - the drift gate byte-compares artifacts, so two people on different terser patch releases would each see the other's artifacts as permanently stale.
